# Highlight.js vendored assets

- Version: 11.12.0
- Upstream: <https://github.com/highlightjs/highlight.js>
- Browser assets: <https://github.com/highlightjs/cdn-release>
- Package: `@highlightjs/cdn-assets@11.12.0`
- Package integrity: `sha512-KvOKXODaiFmId9xaq3xc5xCL66wVLUuOngDbO9B/kewbFTqdGbn2nJxNhN3H5R1cgDTVj6R8vH0zgiNDEGjpDw==`
- Tarball SHA-256: `b8a006d30f45afe783072569f3d69c5b60c0e7b9ca28cd474e12f2584e2a3bd9`
- License: BSD-3-Clause; see `HIGHLIGHTJS_LICENSE.txt`

`highlight.min.js` is the official browser-ready common build. It includes:

`bash`, `c`, `cpp`, `csharp`, `css`, `diff`, `go`, `graphql`, `ini`, `java`,
`javascript`, `json`, `kotlin`, `less`, `lua`, `makefile`, `markdown`,
`objectivec`, `perl`, `php`, `php-template`, `plaintext`, `python`,
`python-repl`, `r`, `ruby`, `rust`, `scss`, `shell`, `sql`, `swift`,
`typescript`, `vbnet`, `wasm`, `xml`, and `yaml`.

The light and dark GitHub themes are copied unmodified as `github.min.css`
and `github-dark.min.css`.
